newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah recovers in London trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah recovers in London trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah recovered against the dollar in the evening after tumbling earlier on false rumours of riots in Jakarta, dealers said.
One U.S. bank dealer said the rupiah recovered to 2,435.0 at 1140 GMT after falling to 2,445 in London trading. Some dealers said the low was 2,447.
The rupiah closed at 2,433.40/33.75 in Jakarta.
The U.S. bank dealer said local players were seen making counter offers in the face of panic rupiah selling by London players who reacted to false rumours of riots in Jakarta.
Dealers said there were rumours in London that a police station was set on fire in the capital. But police in Jakarta said there were no reports of violence in the city.
Fire offices in Jakarta contacted by Reuters said there were no report of fires in Jakarta except for a short circuit in a shop-cum-residence in north Jakarta at midday.
But rumours of trouble persisted through the day as tens of thousands of supporters of the minority United Development Party (PPP) thronged the streets during the ongoing general election campaign.
One Singapore dealer said the over-reaction by London players may have resulted from jitters in the Thai baht which was rattled by offshore attacks through the day.
Dealers said they expected a further recovery in the rupiah as operators switched focus to liquidity, which was expected to be tight on Friday due to higher tax payments.
